local_review.finding_body: The contribution used CompatibleObjectOutputStream to replace Class<?>[] with String[] while serializing FunctionMapperImpl, hiding Tomcat 10.0.17's incompatible normal round trip instead of testing supported behavior; the 10.0.17 source writes Class[] while readExternal reads String[]. It also installed a test-only ExpressionFactory provider and added -H:ServiceLoaderFeatureExcludeServiceProviders solely to make that provider win in Native Image, contrary to the uniform-necessity rule for native flags. The custom provider and MessageFactory additions were unrelated expansion in a JVM runtime repair. These violated FS-test-contract.2.6, FS-test-contract.2.7, and FS-test-contract.2.9.
local_review.finding_title: Runtime repair masked a library serialization regression and required a test-only native build flag
local_review.fix_note: Removed the serialization-stream rewrite while retaining meaningful FunctionMapperImpl mapping and invocation coverage; restored the bundled ExpressionFactory behavior; removed the test-only provider, its native build flag, and unrelated MessageFactory coverage. Forge finalization removed the obsolete service resource metadata and regenerated stats, then passed unchanged on rerun.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete coordinate-scoped diff, local gate evidence, test contract, and fixes-java-run-fail rules. The repaired tree contains no legacy metadata, Native Image skip, compatibility override, or unrelated coordinate change. Repair coverage passes independently: overall 40/45 (88.8889%) to 39/45 (86.6667%), reflection 38/41 (92.6829%) to 37/41 (90.2439%), and resources 2/4 (50%) to 2/4 (50%). The exact Forge finalization command then completed unchanged, including all three native lanes, metadata/style checks, generated-test validation, and regenerated statistics.
